en.summary: A corrective release: the update history now describes everything that arrived in 1.3.1, and its page heading is fixed.
items: Update history now lists the Examination Sets improvements that arrived in version 1.3.1. They are not new in 1.3.2.
The Update history page shows its own title instead of a wrong “Page not found” heading.
The version number and update notices identify this release as 1.3.2.
No change to your records, calculations, reports, Excel files, backups or Print (A4).

sw.summary: Toleo la marekebisho: historia ya masasisho sasa inaeleza kila kitu kilichokuja katika 1.3.1, na kichwa cha ukurasa wake kimerekebishwa.
items: Historia ya masasisho sasa inaorodhesha maboresho ya Seti za Mitihani yaliyokuja katika toleo la 1.3.1. Si mapya katika 1.3.2.
Ukurasa wa Historia ya masasisho unaonyesha kichwa chake badala ya kichwa kisicho sahihi cha “Page not found”.
Nambari ya toleo na taarifa za masasisho zinatambulisha toleo hili kama 1.3.2.
Hakuna mabadiliko kwenye rekodi zako, hesabu, ripoti, faili za Excel, nakala rudufu wala Chapisha (A4).
